title: Docs: Binance investigators found accounts, including those of VIP Chinese traders and a suspected Iranian gold smuggler, helped move $1B to Iran-linked groups (Fortune)
summary: Fortune: Docs: Binance investigators found accounts, including those of VIP Chinese traders and a suspected Iranian gold smuggler, helped move $1B to Iran-linked groups — In early 2025, an embattled Iranian regime was turning increasingly to crypto in order to thwart sanctions choking its economy.
